criteria.text: An object under object lock cannot be deleted or overwritten, even with administrator credentials, until its retention ends
criteria.how: Write a test object with a retention date, then try to delete it as the bucket owner and as an administrator.

criteria.text: A backup job writes to the bucket and a full restore of a test system completes within the agreed time
criteria.how: Run the customer's own backup software against the bucket and time a restore of one system.

criteria.text: Losing one site or node leaves every object readable, with no manual step
criteria.how: Take one site or node offline during reads and check that every object still returns.

criteria.text: Data stays in the countries the policy names, and the placement can be shown to an auditor
criteria.how: Write objects under a residency policy and export where each copy lives.

criteria.text: The customer's existing S3 tools and applications work unchanged against the endpoint
criteria.how: Point two real applications and one command-line tool at the endpoint and run their normal jobs.

criteria.text: The monthly cost for the customer's real volume and access pattern is known before signature, egress and requests included
criteria.how: Replay a month of the customer's usage figures through the price list and agree the total with finance.
